sheets.name: Children and younger students
sheets.brief: Six NEW different child NPCs, roughly ages 8–14, visibly shorter younger proportions than reference teenagers: 1 dark-skinned boy with short curls in mustard cardigan and navy shorts, 2 light-skinned girl with red braided hair in teal dungarees over cream shirt, 3 East Asian child with round glasses in rust hoodie and dark trousers, 4 brown-skinned girl with black ponytail in plum jacket and olive trousers, 5 light-skinned blond boy in blue striped sweater and grey trousers, 6 brown-skinned child with short wavy hair in green raincoat and navy trousers. All closed sneakers, natural relaxed full-body standing poses, no lab chemicals or weapons.

sheets.name: Adult townspeople
sheets.brief: Six NEW adult town NPCs with distinct adult faces and varied adult/older body shapes, not teenagers: 1 older dark-skinned woman with silver curls and teal cardigan, cream blouse and navy skirt with closed shoes; 2 middle-aged light-skinned man with sandy beard, rolled-sleeve cream shirt and olive apron, dark trousers; 3 brown-skinned woman in dark teal headscarf, long rust coat and navy trousers; 4 East Asian older man with grey hair and glasses in navy blazer and tan trousers; 5 light-skinned middle-aged woman with short auburn hair, mustard jacket, plum scarf and dark jeans; 6 dark-skinned middle-aged man with bald head, round glasses, blue work jacket and cream trousers. Empty hands, closed shoes, ordinary friendly townspeople, no costume stereotypes or weapons.

sheets.name: Chemists and laboratory staff
sheets.brief: Six NEW adult scientist and laboratory staff NPCs with distinct faces, ages and body shapes: 1 dark-skinned woman with tied-back natural hair, closed white lab coat over teal shirt and navy trousers; 2 light-skinned older man with silver short beard and hair, closed white lab coat over blue shirt and olive trousers; 3 East Asian woman with black hair in bun, closed pale blue lab coat and dark trousers; 4 brown-skinned man with short black hair and neat beard, closed cream lab coat and burgundy trousers; 5 light-skinned woman with short curly red hair, closed white lab coat over plum shirt and teal trousers; 6 older brown-skinned woman with grey tied-back hair, glasses and closed pale teal lab coat, navy trousers. All wear clear safety goggles over eyes and closed flat shoes. Hands relaxed, some may hold a closed notebook at side; no chemicals, flasks, exposed skin on legs, experiments or weapons. Friendly real scientists, not mad-scientist caricatures.
